description: Creator Analytics Dashboard - Build a real analytics page at src/pages/Analytics.tsx with views, likes, followers gained, engagement rate, top performing posts, and revenue section using recharts (already in package.json). Data from Firestore aggregations.
steps: 1. Rewrite src/pages/Analytics.tsx: Replace the placeholder with a real analytics dashboard. Keep the existing Tabs structure (Overview, Content, Audience, Earnings) but populate with real Firestore data. Use the PageHeader component.

2. Overview tab: (a) Create a views chart using recharts (LineChart or AreaChart) showing views over the last 7/30 days. (b) KPI cards: total views, total likes, new followers (7d), engagement rate (likes+comments / views * 100). (c) Query posts from Firestore where user_id matches, aggregate view_count, like_count. (d) Query follows collection where following_id matches to count new followers.
3. Content tab: Show a list of top performing posts sorted by like_count + view_count descending. Display thumbnail, caption preview, like count, view count, and engagement rate per post.
4. Audience tab: Show follower count, new followers chart (7d/30d periods selectable). Query follows collection.

5. Earnings tab: Show total coins earned from tips (query 'transactions' where recipient_id = user and type = 'tip', sum amounts), subscription earnings placeholder, and total. Use recharts BarChart for monthly breakdown.

6. Create src/hooks/useCreatorAnalytics.ts: Hook that fetches all analytics data from Firestore - posts with metrics, followers, transactions. Returns structured data for the Analytics page. Use date-fns for date range calculations.
7. Add a test src/pages/Analytics.test.tsx verifying the component renders the tabs.
acceptance_criteria: Analytics page shows real data from Firestore queries (posts, follows, transactions)
Overview has charts (recharts) and KPI cards with actual metrics
Content tab shows top posts sorted by engagement
Earnings tab shows coin earnings from tips
Period selector (7d/30d) works for time-based data
